extName.message: iCloud+ Hide My Email Creator & Copier

extDescription.message: Create an iCloud+ Hide My Email address labeled with the current site and copy it to the clipboard.

actionTitle.message: Create a Hide My Email address

subtitle.message: Create and copy an iCloud+ address

siteHintEditable.message: You can edit the site name.

statusIdle.message: Click “Create and copy” to prepare iCloud+ in the background and create an address. This tab stays in front. You may need to sign in to Apple the first time.

statusPreparing.message: Preparing the iCloud+ Hide My Email screen…

statusCreating.message: Creating the address… Please wait to avoid creating duplicates.

statusSuccessCopied.message: Address created and copied to the clipboard.

statusUncertain.message: Could not confirm the creation result. Check it in iCloud.

statusError.message: The address could not be created.

errAuthRequired.message: Sign in to Apple. Open iCloud and sign in.

errSessionExpired.message: Your iCloud session expired. Open iCloud and sign in again.

errNetwork.message: The connection failed. Check your network and try again.

errNoIcloudPlus.message: Could not open Hide My Email. Check your iCloud+ subscription.

errUiNotFound.message: Could not find the iCloud+ screen. The interface may have changed. Check in iCloud.

errCreateFailed.message: Could not create the address. Check the iCloud screen.

errTimeout.message: iCloud did not respond in time. Open iCloud and check the status.

errResultUnknown.message: Could not confirm the creation result. Check it in iCloud.

statusStateUnavailable.message: Could not read the extension state. Reopen the popup.

statusCopyFailed.message: Could not copy. Select the address and copy it manually.

errorNoLabel.message: Enter a label. The current site name is filled in automatically.

errorStartFailed.message: Could not start. Reopen the popup.

errorReviewNeeded.message: Check the previous result before resuming. Automatic retry is disabled to prevent duplicates.

errorBusy.message: A creation is already in progress. Wait until it finishes.

reviewLead.message: Automatic retry is disabled to prevent duplicate addresses.

reviewCheck.message: I checked the result in iCloud

footer.message: Passwords and verification codes are never handled. The created address is kept only in this browser session.
